ruled_out_vectors.vector: C1: Core→PoolType trust — mock pool type returns amountOut > actual tokens moved
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule.sol:2208 balance check: balanceInBefore + swapCache.amountIn != balanceInAfter → revert. L1400-1405: actualAmountIn > originalAmountIn → revert. L3520-3528: _safeDecrementUint128 prevents output > reserves. Triple guard makes pool type lying impossible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C2: Core→Handler mismatch — handler expects different token pair than Core sends
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule.sol:2208 balance validation catches any mismatch: if handler doesn't transfer correct amounts, balance check reverts. Handler is called with exact token/amount from swap params at L2272-2321.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C3: Core→Hook fee manipulation — hook returns fee > swap amount in beforeSwap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule.sol:2598-2677 fee application: fees are BPS-bounded (max 10000 = 100%), deducted with underflow protection. Hook fees come from BPS calculation, cannot exceed amountIn. _validateProtocolFees at L1654-1677 ensures totalFees <= amountIn.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C4: Hook→Registry settings change between beforeSwap and afterSwap in same TX
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook._requireCallerIsRegistry() at L933-937 ensures only the registry contract can call settings update functions. Registry functions (registryUpdateTokenSettings, registryUpdatePricingBounds) are admin-only. No reentrancy path exists from swap callbacks to registry update.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C5: PoolType→Core return — mock pool returning feeAmount > amountIn
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule.sol:1654-1677 _validateProtocolFees: totalFees <= amountIn check. L1400-1405: actualAmountIn > originalAmountIn → revert. Pool type cannot inflate fees beyond input amount.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C6: Handler→External reentrancy — MaliciousToken reenters AMM from PermitTransferHandler callback
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule uses reentrancy guard (ENTERED bit) that persists through entire swap execution including fee distribution. Hook flag INV-H05 verified. Any reentrant call reverts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C7: INV-H01 — Hook callback access control — external caller invokes hook functions directly
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook._requireCallerIsAMM() at L940-944 guards beforeSwap (L110), afterSwap (L159), validateAddLiquidity (L253), validatePoolCreation (L312). All hook callbacks revert when called from non-AMM address. Forge test confirms all 5 entry points revert.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C8: INV-H02 — Settlement conservation — handler creates or destroys tokens during settlement
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule.sol:2208 balance validation: balanceInBefore + swapCache.amountIn != balanceInAfter → revert. This enforces exact conservation. Handler cannot create or destroy tokens without triggering the balance check.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C9: INV-H04 Hook Fee Integrity — hook charges max fee on every swap, sum exceeds cap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fees are BPS-bounded per-swap (max 10000 BPS = 100% of swap amount). _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers uses underflow-protected subtraction. Each fee is capped individually and deducted from the swap amount. No accumulation overflow possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C10: INV-SW04 Output Bounded by Reserves — swap outputs more than pool holds
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule.sol:3520-3528 _safeDecrementUint128: assembly underflow check prevents outputting more than reserves. If amountOut > reserve, the subtraction underflows and reverts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C11: INV-S04 Denomination Consistency — fee computed in cheap token transferred as expensive token
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fee computation in AMMModule uses token-specific paths: fees are computed per-token (tokenIn fees in tokenIn, tokenOut fees in tokenOut). Call graph from Slither confirms fee flow stays within same denomination. No cross-denomination transfer path exists.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C12: INV-E03 Sandwich Resistance — victim receives less than limitAmount due to sandwich
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule swap functions enforce limitAmount: if output < limitAmount, the swap reverts. This is a hard check on every swap. Attacker can front-run but victim's swap reverts if output drops below their specified minimum.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C13: PoolDecoder crafted poolId — max values in every field, missing 6 leading zero bytes
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: PoolDecoder.getPoolType extracts address via POOL_TYPE_ADDRESS_MASK requiring 6 leading zero bytes. Pool type addresses without this constraint are masked to a different address. createPool validates pool type exists at the decoded address.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C14: createPool with edge parameters — zero tick spacing, max fee, extreme sqrtPrice
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool type createPool implementations validate parameters. DynamicPoolType validates tick spacing > 0, fee within bounds, sqrtPrice within MIN_SQRT_RATIO/MAX_SQRT_RATIO. Edge parameters trigger reverts in pool type validation.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C15: Storage slot collision across diamond facets (AMMModule, ModuleAdmin, ModuleFeeCollection, ModuleLiquidity)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Slither storage layout analysis confirms all 4 modules have 0 storage slots. All state is stored at the diamond's 0x9A1D base slot via explicit struct access. No slot collision possible when modules use 0 direct storage.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMModule.sol uses LimitBreakAMMStorageKey (0x9A1D) for all state, verified via mcp__slither__get_storage_layout showing 0 slots for all 4 modules

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C16: _validatePricingBounds — verify no code path skips bounds check
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Code analysis of AMMStandardHook.sol:823-871: _validatePricingBounds is called from both beforeSwap (L135) and afterSwap (L180) for both tokenIn and tokenOut. All paths through bounds.isSet check enforce min/max sqrtPriceX96 validation. Operator precedence verified correct via dedicated Forge test (Solidity | has higher precedence than ==).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C19: Bunni-pattern hook/pool accounting desync — revert in afterSwap with beforeSwap state persisted
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook.beforeSwap writes to transient storage (DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT) only for direct swaps. If afterSwap reverts, the entire transaction reverts (EVM atomicity). beforeSwap state changes cannot persist without afterSwap completing. No partial state possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C20: Diamond selector collision — 4-byte collision across all modules and pool types
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: LimitBreakAMM uses explicit facet routing via SecureProxy, NOT selector-based dispatch. Each module is registered as a specific facet with known selectors. Pool types are external contracts called via ILimitBreakAMMPoolType interface, not diamond facets. No selector-based routing = no collision attack surface.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C21: Transient storage cross-path — beforeSwap tstore read by addLiquidity/removeLiquidity/collectFees
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT is only written in _validatePricingBounds during beforeSwap (L839) and only read during afterSwap in the same function (L843-844). addLiquidity, removeLiquidity, and collectFees do not call _validatePricingBounds with isBeforeSwap=false for direct swap path. No cross-path tload exists.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C22: Hook return value manipulation — Uni V4 vectors — mock hook returns manipulated values from beforeSwap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook.beforeSwap returns (bytes4 selector, uint24 fee, uint256 hookFeeAmount). AMMModule validates: fee is BPS-bounded, hookFeeAmount deducted with underflow protection, selector must match expected. Hook cannot inflate fees beyond BPS cap or manipulate return values to extract value.
